headline: Public analytics now explain their denominators, the Studio ecosystem has its own evidence-backed view, and every Desk illustration has privacy-safe reactions and reader-attention measurement.

items.title: Cloudflare analytics became a source-attributed public measurement plane
items.insight: Project traffic, edge requests, performance samples, and unavailable audience coverage are now named separately instead of being blended into one misleading number.

items.title: The Studio ecosystem gained a dedicated analytics explorer
items.insight: Twenty-nine active Cloudflare zones are classified into production, staging, and internal surfaces, with source dates, filters, and honest unavailable states.

items.title: Every generated Desk illustration gained its own reaction and attention loop
items.insight: Like, fire, laugh, and wow reactions are scoped to each figure and only appear accepted after the server confirms them; article presence and visible-focused reading time stay privacy-thresholded.

items.title: The new surfaces are covered by visual, accessibility, performance, and contract receipts
items.insight: Seven themes, desktop and mobile, reaction states, Worker behavior, public contracts, and local performance are measured rather than inferred.

followUps: Confirm audience measurement for vaultsparkstudios.com with a narrow Cloudflare account-settings credential.
After the held Worker release clears, connect sample-gated Desk reader signals to the Director's Report.
blockers: The available analytics token can read zone and account analytics but cannot inspect or activate the main site's audience-measurement configuration.
The new Desk reaction and presence endpoints remain held with the existing identity-sensitive Worker release; static controls degrade honestly until that release is authorized.
